description: Scrabble Word Finder — enter your rack and find the highest-scoring plays from a 5,200-word dictionary.

faqs.a: Type up to 15 letters; use ? for blank tiles (worth 0 points). The finder checks all 5,200 dictionary words and ranks every word you can build by Scrabble score.
faqs.q: How do I enter blank tiles?

faqs.a: Standard English values (Q10, Z10, J8, X8…). Blanks always score 0, even on a triple-letter square — the tool accounts for that.
A curated 5,200-word list of common English words. Tournament play uses much larger lists (CSW/NWL), so treat this as a strong casual helper, not a referee.
faqs.q: How big is the word list?

howto: Type your rack letters (up to 15), ? for blanks.
Optionally set a minimum word length.
Press “Find plays” — results rank by score.
Blank tiles are marked and always score 0.
title: Scrabble Word Finder
